title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1978-12-31
source: Source: sbd > master reel (15ips half track) > pcm > dat (44.1k) - Provided by Rich Gastwirt; Transfer: Dat > Panasonic SV-3700 > Tascam DA-3000; wav 16/44.1 - Transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16edited and mastered SIRMick

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording with a standout Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain sequence
ai_review.review: The Miller/Gastwirt‑mastered soundboard capture is praised as essentially flawless after an initial balloon‑drop pop that settles by the first major jam. Reviewers hail this performance—especially the Scarlet>Fire transition—as the best version they’ve heard, making it an essential download.

ai_rating.rationale: A single five‑star review highlights both superb musical performance and high‑quality recording (minor initial noise), leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Initial balloon drop and popping noise in the opener, but clarity and balance settle quickly; overall crisp and well‑mastered.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: A noisy opening fades into a tight, high‑energy set; the Scarlet>Fire sequence is highlighted as a peak moment.
